# open-mercato-generator

Node-based tooling for generating Rust types for Open Mercato from OpenAPI.

## Install

```bash
cd generator
yarn install
```

## Generate

```bash
# Full client and models (recommended)
yarn generate:rust-types:full /path/to/openapi.json

# Simplified structures
yarn generate:rust-types:openapi /path/to/openapi.json

# From TypeScript openapi.types.ts
yarn generate:rust-types:typescript /path/to/openapi.types.ts
```

Generated output is written into `../rust-client/src/generated` and
`../rust-client/src/generated-full`.

## Version syncing

To keep versions aligned with the Rust crate:

```bash
yarn sync:versions 0.3.13
```

## Publish

```bash
npm publish
```
